bucket.description: The name of the bucket the object is stored in.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

object.description: The name of the object to apply the acl to.

predefined_acl.description: The "canned" [predefined ACL](https://cloud.google.com/storage/docs/access-control#predefined-acl) to apply. Must be set if `role_entity` is not.
predefined_acl.rationale: This should be disabled to enforce fine-grained control via 'role_entity

role_entity.description: List of role/entity pairs in the form `ROLE:entity`. See [GCS Object ACL documentation](https://cloud.google.com/storage/docs/json_api/v1/objectAccessControls) for more details.
role_entity.rationale: Defines role:entity ACL pairs on the object. A policy should reject entries granting public/wildcard principals (allUsers, allAuthenticatedUsers) to prevent anonymous object access, without enumerating which specific identities are allowed.
